verdict.rationale: AI-generated incident and alert summaries are a fair question for an observability and incident-management platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack contains only page titles for Bits AI and Incident Management, with no content stating that Datadog generates summaries of incidents or alert context for responders. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders
